hebrewText: ט֤וּב טַ֣עַם וָ/דַ֣עַת לַמְּדֵ֑/נִי כִּ֖י בְ/מִצְוֺתֶ֣י/ךָ הֶאֱמָֽנְתִּי

tokens.bdb: good (as a noun), in the widest sense, especially goodness (superlative concretely, the best), beauty, gladness, welfare
tokens.kjv: fair, gladness, good(-ness, thing, -s), joy, go well with.

tokens.bdb: properly, a taste, i.e. (figuratively) perception; by implication, intelligence; transitively, a mandate
tokens.kjv: advice, behaviour, decree, discretion, judgment, reason, taste, understanding.

tokens.bdb: properly, to goad, i.e. (by implication) to teach (the rod being an Oriental incentive)
tokens.kjv: (un-) accustomed, [idiom] diligently, expert, instruct, learn, skilful, teach(-er, -ing).

tokens.bdb: (by implication) very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb (as below); often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.kjv: and, + (forasmuch, inasmuch, where-) as, assured(-ly), + but, certainly, doubtless, + else, even, + except, for, how, (because, in, so, than) that, + nevertheless, now, rightly, seeing, since, surely, then, therefore, + (al-) though, + till, truly, + until, when, whether, while, whom, yea, yet.
tokens.enLiteralWord: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed
tokens.explanation: ki — conjunção causal e explicativa: porque, pois, que, quando
tokens.explanationEn: very widely used as a relative conjunction or adverb ; often largely modified by other particles annexed

tokens.bdb: a command, whether human or divine (collectively, the Law)
properly, to build up or support; to foster as a parent or nurse; figuratively to render (or be) firm or faithful, to trust or believe, to be permanent or quiet; morally to be true or certain;
tokens.kjv: hence, assurance, believe, bring up, establish, [phrase] fail, be faithful (of long continuance, stedfast, sure, surely, trusty, verified), nurse, (-ing father), (put), trust, turn to the right.
